title: `CEther.doTransferOut` Uses 2300-Gas `transfer`, Bricking Interactions with Contract Wallets
impact: `CEther.doTransferOut` uses `to.transfer(amount)` with a hard 2300 gas stipend. Any recipient whose `receive()`/`fallback()` consumes more than 2300 gas (smart-contract wallets like Gnosis Safe, account-abstraction wallets, multi-sigs with logging) will cause the transfer to revert. This blocks `redeem`, `borrow`, `repayBorrow` (overpayment refund), `_reduceReserves`, and liquidation payouts to such recipients. An attacker who controls a borrower address that is a contract can make their position **unliquidatable** if the liquidator's `seize`/transfer-out path must send Ether to them, and users with contract wallets cannot exit their positions — funds are effectively frozen.
